mapper.select: select count(file_id) from data_file_status where analysis_date=#{analysis_date}
mapper.update: update data_file_status set product_name = #{product_name} where subbarcode=#{subbarcode} and analysis_date=#{analysis_date} and product_name = #{oldProductName}
mapper.delete: delete from data_file_status where analysis_date = #{analysis_date} and (status = 'Pending' or status = 'Error')
